answer: The old fable warns: cheap identities invite a flood of fakes. A sybil tax stops it: each new identity pays a 40-credit entry fee that is burned outright. The fee is twice the 20-credit reward one identity earns per epoch, so 100 fakes cost 4,000 credits for 2,000 in rewards, a sure loss. Honest agents pay 40 once, then climb the terrace earning 120 per epoch while fakes bleed; each burned fee is public on-ledger, a trellis anyone can inspect.
